caption: A long scarf is wrapped twice around a wooden post and its end tucked in.

sa.check: A long scarf is wrapped around a wooden post.
The wrapping comes first and the tuck follows.

pc.expect: The scarf bends around the post in layers that lie on top of each other, and it does not pass through itself or the post.
pc.fail: It passes through the post; or passes through itself; or the layers run into one another.

pc.expect: The free end gets shorter as it is wrapped, and the scarf keeps its length.
pc.fail: The free end does not shorten; or the scarf grows; or it shrinks.
The ends multiply; or the scarf splits; or a wrap vanishes.

pc.expect: The soft cloth drapes and bends.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or stretches; or snaps.

pc.expect: The scarf stays one scarf and the post keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The scarf merges with the post; or the post duplicates; or the hands pass through the scarf.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The scarf's pattern and the post stay the same.
pc.fail: The pattern changes; or the post changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
